svg.aria-label: Eleven pull requests by Saad Anjum merged into nvm, anything-llm, TheAlgorithms/Java, python-patterns, kitty, lucide, Ciphey, bash-it, caprover, flux2 and neo
svg.text: Fixes accepted by the maintainers of these projects in October 2026, each with a reproduction and a regression test where the project has a suite.

g.text: Repo provider check sent the wrong
KeyError in BFS graph search when a
Rail-fence cipher sized its zigzag by
Alias completion threw a syntax error
logging-in user, not the query account
Plugin archive entries with a leading
Hybrid sync re-ran semantic dedup on pulled
memories, so synced hashes never arrived
